_comment: Soundboard catalogue (1.99rh, soundboards.js). Clips are TTS lines Pepe renders once (VoiceBox) and caches; 'voice' null = Pepe's default voice, 'random' = a random free stock voice picked at render time (re-rolled every play when 'live'). Rarity sets the per-use price (common 1,000 / rare 2,500 / epic 5,000) and the length cap (6 / 8 / 10 s; legendaries 12 s). Ids are permanent: never reuse or rename one (ownership and plays point at them). Packs: owners play their clips free (cooldowns still apply); anyone else pays per use. Legendaries are own-only. The season board is unlimited with a Season Pass and per-use (2,500) for everyone else.
